content:
I've open-sourced the code for my ARC-AGI-3 milestone submission. This notebook scored 0.86 on the public leaderboard and reached 3rd place at the time of submission.

You can find it here: ARC-AGI-3 LB 0.86(3rd place candidate- Milestone)

The agent runs a local Gemma 4 31B vision-language model through vLLM inside the Kaggle notebook. For each game, it converts recent ARC-AGI-3 frames into chronological images with step labels, asks the model for JSON actions, validates/repairs the action output, keeps a short per-game reflection memory, and sends actions back through the official ARC-AGI-3 environment.

Side note: I just recently started working on this competition, and I was focused primarily on Neurogolf. Even yesterday, my score was 0.33. I want to give a huge thanks to @ko0kip for this notebook. My submission was an improved version of this one. Credit to my Codex agent too for such a huge improvement in one shot xD
I’m really glad to see you made such big improvements on my notebook! That’s amazing—this is exactly what open source is all about. Hope we can enjoy this competition together.😉
